title: Support confined task-sync cleanup under restricted Linux procfs
outcome: Support confined task-sync cleanup under restricted Linux procfs
acceptance: A Linux behavior test with unrelated unreadable process-stat records proves that terminal owned Git can finish without treating unrelated processes as members.

The verifier preserves a fail-closed response whenever it cannot establish that the owned group became terminal. A supported refusal happens before spawning any Git if required process visibility is unavailable.
